editorial.blurb: A TikTok-famous boba spot in Chinatown known for perfectly chewy tapioca pearls and flavorful teas, though quality can be inconsistent.
editorial.insiderTip: Order at the kiosk for a smooth experience and quick service; ask specifically about flavor intensity since some reviewers found drinks bland or watered down.

topDishes.note: great flavor with perfectly sweetened boba pearls
